run_art_preprocessing: run the ART dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_art_dataset_instance: create an ART dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace ART dataset for classification tasks
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace ART dataset split to a list of input-output tuples with observations and hypotheses
load_art_dataset: load the ART dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the ART dataset with a specified seed
